scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd apps/web && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && cd ../../packages/db && npm install && cd ../api-client && npm install && cd ../api-zod && npm install && cd ../api-client-react && npm install
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:libs && npm run typecheck:apps
scripts.typecheck:libs: cd packages/db && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../api-client && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../api-zod && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.typecheck:apps: cd apps/web && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../server && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.clean: rm -rf apps/*/dist apps/*/.turbo packages/*/dist node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules
